human colostrums are a good additive for growth of human mammary epithelial cell.
human mammary epithelial cell lines can be established from normal mammary glands and from breast cancer tissue by the use of human colostrums and collagenase.
human mammary tumor and normal mammary epithelial cell cultures can be established by the use of a collagenase digestion method with the addition of human colostrums milk to culture medium.

the development of a method for the short-term cultivation of normal human mammary epithelial tissue and human breast cancer.
the development of a method for short-term cultivation of epithelial cells derived from human mammary tumors or normal mammary tissues.
the short-term cultivation of mammary tumors and the normal human breast.
